title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：patience　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 patience 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the counsellor ① kept the patience that no listener in the garden would have counted, and he said the keeping was the whole of the evening. The ② patience, meaning the calm itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed uncounted in the book; patience, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ bit of patience in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ patience at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Patience, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the counsellor said the counting is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the patience was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the calm. The ⑥ patience, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; patience, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both calm and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ patience had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ patience of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of counting; patience, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ patience I remember is the patience counted in the journal, which closed in 2000 and is still counted as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Patience, my mother said in 2002, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all patience, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like calm. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 耐心；忍耐（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 耐心；忍耐（指那份耐心本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the patience 保持这一份耐心
D. n. 耐心；忍耐（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 耐心之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的耐心之事）
F. n. 耐心；忍耐（指心记里写到、被清点的那一份）
G. n. 耐心、韧劲（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 韧劲（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the patience that no listener in the garden would have counted
The patience, meaning the calm itself and not the letter
Every bit of patience in that garden
the patience at the far bench
the patience was the whole of the matter
the patience had become a line in a journal
The patience of the whole thing

answers.why: keep the patience 意为“保持这一份耐心”，1993 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯清点的一份耐心做了一遍。
patience 意为“耐心；忍耐”，指那份耐心本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被清点。
patience 意为“耐心；忍耐”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
patience 意为“耐心；忍耐”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
patience 意为“耐心、韧劲”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份韧劲就是那件事的全部。
patience 意为“韧劲”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份耐心，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
patience 意为“耐心；忍耐”，指心记里写到、被清点的那一份，到 1998 年这一份成了心记里的一行。
patience 意为“耐心之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的耐心之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的清点。
patience 意为“耐心；忍耐”，我记得的是心记里清点过的那一份，2000 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一份。
patience 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，耐心是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的耐心。
